query:
SELECT bc.id, bc.client_name, bc.client_id, bc.value, bc.status, bc.type, bc.description, bc.due_date, bc.paid_date, bc.classified_by
FROM bpo_charges bc
WHERE bc.description LIKE '%Pix recebido%'
  AND bc.status IN ('received', 'confirmed', 'receivedInCash')
ORDER BY bc.due_date DESC
LIMIT 30
